decision_criteria.POST_DECISION_TASK_RANDOMNESS_DOMINATES: YES when equal-weight within-state variance fraction >=0.50 and at least half of selected states have sign stability <0.80; NO when fraction <=0.25 and median state sign stability >=0.90; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_criteria.REALIZED_DELTA_Q_IS_HIGH_NOISE_TARGET: Uses the same stochasticity and sign-flip evidence; no conclusion is drawn from variance alone.
decision_criteria.CONDITIONAL_EXPECTED_DELTA_Q_STATE_DEPEN: YES requires at least two reliably positive and two reliably negative state means (mean beyond 1.96 Monte Carlo SE), with opposite reliable signs occurring within at least one repeated run/head group.
decision_criteria.TRIGGER_OBSERVATION_DEFICIENCY_STILL_SUP: INCONCLUSIVE when only 16 states are available for a 400-dimensional context; nearest/linear metrics are descriptive and do not establish cross-state generalization.

protocol.task_sampling: Called formal scenario.task_scenario.generate_tasks for one fixed slot per draw, conditioning on that episode/slot's fixed rho_star from popularity.csv; independently resampled task arrivals, service IDs, input jitter, and workload jitter. rho_star, predictions, horizon/time metadata, positions, checkpoint and head remained fixed.
protocol.common_random_numbers: The same task RNG seed tuple was used across checkpoints and heads for matching realization/slot/draw.
protocol.task_observation_firewall: actual task draws are supplied only to execute_slot; they are never passed to policy or Trigger observation.
protocol.q_definition: Q_keep = reward_keep + gamma*V(next_keep); Q_update_expected = sum frozen pi_old(c|UPDATE)*(reward_c+gamma*V(next_c)); delta = Q_update_expected-Q_keep.
protocol.candidate_probabilities: Frozen policy's conditional UPDATE candidate probabilities computed once from the unchanged pre-decision Trigger context and official candidate enumeration.
protocol.variance_decomposition: Equal-weight across selected states: mean within-state population variance divided by itself plus population variance of state-level Monte Carlo means.
protocol.other_cache_decisions_fixed: All other 8 Cache decisions and both UAV decisions remain from the same replayed production transition for every KEEP/UPDATE branch and task draw.
protocol.per_state_predecision_snapshots_include: previous_cache_state, previous_uav_positions, predicted vehicle positions/popularity and horizons, mask, time-to-go, slot/origin/time, frozen policy observation and candidate probabilities; actual vehicle positions are fixed across draws.

raw_context_descriptive_relation.scope: descriptive only; no generalization claim (selected N is small and p>N)

prior_raw_observation_probe.previous_target: single-realization symmetric expected delta-Q at each sample; no task-realization marginalization
prior_raw_observation_probe.interpretation: This conditional task-resampling diagnosis tests whether post-decision task noise can explain the previous realized-target probe failure.
